name: list_services
description: Silent internal lookup that returns current services, prices, descriptions, stable service IDs, and the shop's general hours and last appointment start times. Use it to resolve the caller's requested service or answer a shop-hours question. Do not announce or describe this lookup to the caller.

name: list_shop_openings
description: Check booked appointments, shop hours, and barber working hours to find openings on a requested local date, either across all active barbers or for a caller's preferred barber. The response includes the shop's general hours and last appointment start times. Use before requiring a service when a caller wants to schedule and is choosing a barber, day, or time. Pass today or tomorrow exactly when the caller uses a relative date so the server resolves it in the shop's timezone; never convert a caller's relative date to a year yourself. The response's dateSpoken and relativeToShopToday fields are authoritative; never calculate a weekday or relative-day name yourself. A date interpretation error is not an availability result: retry using the caller's original relative word. If there are no openings, follow dateGuidance and check nextCalendarDate before offering it. Omit date to check today and omit barberName when anyone is acceptable.

date.description: Optional date. Pass today, tomorrow, or day after tomorrow exactly when spoken by the caller; otherwise use YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to check today. Never guess the year or weekday for a relative date; speak the dateSpoken value returned by the tool.

barberName.description: Optional preferred barber name or nickname exactly as spoken by the caller, such as Brayden, Abby, or Dale. The server resolves full names, first names, and configured nicknames to the same barber. Omit to check every active barber.

name: list_barbers
description: Silent internal validation that returns active barbers who offer the selected service, including each barber's configured nickname and recognized aliases. Treat the name, first name, nickname, and aliases as the same barber. Use a serviceId returned by list_services. Do not announce or describe this lookup to the caller.

serviceId.description: The stable service ID returned by list_services.

name: list_available_slots
description: Return currently open 30-minute appointment start times, the shop's general hours and last appointment start times, and an authoritative availabilityStatus for an eligible barber on a specific local calendar date. Follow responseGuidance: day-off means the barber is not scheduled, fully-booked means the barber is working but has no remaining slots, and workday-ended means today's shift is over. Never describe one status as another. This is the final step in one silent availability lookup chain; do not narrate prior service or barber validation. Call immediately before offering times and again if the caller changes the barber, service, or date. Speak the returned dateSpoken value and never calculate the weekday yourself.

serviceId.description: The stable service ID returned by list_services.

barberId.description: The barber ID returned by list_barbers.

date.description: Local appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: book_appointment
description: Create a confirmed appointment after the caller explicitly confirms the service, barber, local date, time, name, and callback number. Use only IDs and a time returned by the earlier tools.

serviceId.description: The stable service ID returned by list_services.

barberId.description: The barber ID returned by list_barbers.

date.description: Local appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

phone.description: Customer's confirmed callback phone number, preferably E.164.

notes.description: Optional concise appointment notes requested by the customer.

smsConsent.description: True only when the caller explicitly agrees to receive this appointment's confirmation and reminder text messages; otherwise false.
